name: Feather Fall

header.Casting Time: Reaction, which you take when you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls
header.Components: V, M (a small feather or piece of down)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.casting_time: Reaction, which you take when you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls
casting.material: a small feather or piece of down

authored_intent: Reaction when caster or seen creature falls; choose up to five falling creatures within range; fall rate 60 feet/round and no landing damage if landing before ending; ends for each on landing, with no invented automatic on-feet benefit.

rules.text: Choose up to five falling creatures within range.
A falling creature’s rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends.
If a creature lands before the spell ends, the creature takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.
